items.q: I'm the guy who named him Honeybear... I said look, he look like a little honey bear... so they started -- started saying, Honey Baby Bear!

ctx.x: Now the one person -- the two people who seemed to be as consistent as you, through the -- not quite as consistent, but all through, are Gene Sedric and Al Casey. What -- tell me something about Gene Sedric? What sort of a person was Gene?
Aw, a lovable little guy. I'm the guy who named him Honeybear.
